property_summary: For any caller other than the current owner, transferOwnership must revert and never change the owner, while a call from the current owner succeeds and sets owner to the new value; the inverted mutant instead lets non-owners take ownership and blocks the owner, so it fails for some fuzzed (caller, newOwner) input.
change_summary: Invert the access check so the guarded function/transfer only works for non-owners.
